The level sits 7.26 pts below the D-1 reference close 7509.10 (14 May 2026 cash session), i.e. at or below it, the correct side for a buy limit.
management_text: Three equal units, filled only if price trades down to 7501.84. Unit 1 exits at TP1 7533.70 (daily R1). Unit 2 exits at TP2 7546.00 (daily R1.5); on the Unit-2 fill the Unit-3 stop moves to entry + 0.2R = 7506.48. Unit 3 (runner) traces to TP3 7558.30 (daily R2). R = 23.22 pts = 0.35 x ATR14, below 1.00 so no wide-stop flag; 2R = 46.44 pts is far inside 3 x ATR14 = 201.03, so no 'TP2 ambitious' flag. Thesis invalidation (separate from the stop): a daily close back through daily P 7498.30, which sits 19.68 pts above the stop. One holding period only; no HIGH-impact scheduled US event appears on D in the calendar slice.
rationale: REBUILT IN THE CORROBORATION CORRECTION PASS. The prior draw suppressed this card under the M5 10 trigger 'all accessible pivot tiers SINGLE-SOURCE-INDICATIVE'. That was a misapplication and is reversed here. The flag it relied on was inherited from the report's own text, which described the provenance of the report's quoted intraday H/L - a weaker input that the card does not use. M5 5.2a and M5 10 state that the flag describes the provenance of the H/L/C actually used to compute the tier, and that a tier computed from the execution price series is CORROBORATED by construction: that series is the one the resulting order is filled and settled against, so it is the settlement source rather than a secondary quote about the market, and there is nothing for a second source to corroborate it against. The gate exists for tiers struck from narrative or aggregator quotes whose true prior-period H/L cannot be established; it is not reached here. PIVOT TIER AND ITS CORROBORATION: the daily floor-pivot tier is recomputed from the broker execution price series in data/slices/US500/US500_upto_2026-05-14.csv, prior period = the D-1 US500 cash session of 2026-05-14 (16:30-23:00 broker), H 7522.90 / L 7462.90 / C 7509.10. Corroboration flag: CORROBORATED - series = the US500 broker price series (slice US500_upto_2026-05-14.csv, last bar 2026-05-14 23:45:00 broker); session = the 2026-05-14 cash session 16:30-23:00 broker. The tier is therefore not inherited from the report and carries no indicative flag. Levels: P = (H+L+C)/3 = 7498.30; R1 = 2P - L = 7533.70; R2 = P + (H-L) = 7558.30; R3 = H + 2(P-L) = 7593.70; S1 = 2P - H = 7473.70; S2 = P - (H-L) = 7438.30; S3 = L - 2(H-P) = 7413.70; the M5 4a midpoint R1.5 = (R1+R2)/2 = 7546.00 and S1.5 = (S1+S2)/2 = 7456.00 inherit the same CORROBORATED flag as their parent tier. The report's own daily pivots (P 7481.23 / S1 7457.16) rest on H 7505.30 / L 7436.80, 17.6 and 26.1 pts from the series, and are not used. SUPPRESSION TESTS RE-RUN, ALL NEGATIVE. (i) Pivot corroboration: the daily tier is CORROBORATED as above, so it is not the case that all accessible tiers are indicative; the trigger does not fire. (ii) Conviction: Trade 2 is fully regime-driven under M5 5.2 and does not inherit the 2 score, so the NEUTRAL trigger does not reach it; for the record the report's directional score is +0.78 LONG, above its +0.25 threshold, so it would not have fired in any case. (iii) Confirmed break: the 4d break test governs Trade 3C only, not this card. (iv) TRANSITION breakout-side restriction: the regime label is TREND_UP - 9 of the report states 'Composite regime label is TREND_UP' and 21b repeats it, and the same label forks Trade 3A on this date - so the 5.2c restriction is not engaged. (v) Qualifying swing: the 4b swing test governs Trade 3A/3B, not this card. (vi) R band: R = 23.22 pts = 0.35 x ATR14, inside 0.3-3.0 x ATR14 = [20.10, 201.03], so the branch geometry does satisfy the band and there is no rule-fixed-geometry ground either. No ground for suppression survives, so the card is built. The prior draw's second reason is also withdrawn: it read the TREND-branch entry as necessarily a buy stop and, finding 7501.84 below the reference close, called the geometry unexecutable. M5 5.2b prescribes 'Stop or limit at P + 0.10 x (R1 - P)'. The level is unchanged and is the branch's own; only the order type follows from where it falls relative to the reference close. A buy limit at 7501.84 is at or below the close 7509.10 as M5 5.0 requires, so the card is issued as a limit. This is not borrowing mean-reversion geometry into a TREND branch - the price comes from the 5.2b row, not from the 5.2a pivot-fade row, and no S1/S1.5/S2 fade tier is used. REFERENCE CLOSE: 7509.10, the settled close of the last completed cash session strictly before D, dated 2026-05-14, from the slice; identical to the value the other cards on this date use. ANCHOR: 09:00 broker = 07:00 UK, the fixed daily-open anchor. ATR14 = 67.01 index points on the last 14 completed US500 cash-session bars (16:30-23:00 broker) ending 2026-05-14, true-range definition; identical to the value the other cards on this date use. 0.25 x ATR14 = 16.75; 2.5 x ATR14 = 167.53; 3 x ATR14 = 201.03. ENTRY: P + 0.10 x (R1 - P) = 7498.30 + 0.10 x 35.40 = 7501.84, issued as a buy limit; signed gap to the reference close = -7.26 pts. STOP: the 5.2b long rule P - 0.8 x (P - S1) = 7498.30 - 0.8 x 24.60 = 7498.30 - 19.68 = 7478.62. The confluence alternative was tested: of the named candidates the 5-day swing low 7345.30 and weekly S1 7249.57 are far below S1 and do not sit 'just below' it, while the prior-day cash low 7462.90 sits 10.80 pts (0.16 x ATR14) below S1 and gives 'just below S1 minus 0.25 x ATR14' = 7473.70 - 16.75 = 7456.95, which is wider; the rule takes whichever is tighter, so 7478.62 stands. R = 7501.84 - 7478.62 = 23.22 pts = 0.35 x ATR14, inside the required band [20.10, 201.03] and below 1.00, so no wide-stop flag. TARGETS are the 5.2b ladder R1 / R1.5 / R2 = 7533.70 / 7546.00 / 7558.30, all on the CORROBORATED daily tier. TP1 is 31.86 pts from entry, well inside the 2.5 x ATR14 = 167.53 bound. Ladder is ordered stop 7478.62 < entry 7501.84 < TP1 7533.70 < TP2 7546.00 < TP3 7558.30. Thesis invalidation is a daily close back through daily P 7498.30, a named structural level 19.68 pts from the stop, i.e. more than 0.15 x ATR14 = 10.05 away from it. No fib percentages and no monthly-pivot confluence enter this card, so the report's monthly-R2 artefact does not propagate. The report shipped its version of this card on an asserted user directive; that override is removed, and the card standing here is built from the branch rules on the recomputed tier, not restored from the report. Linter: CLEAN, zero DUD, zero WARN.

entry_mode_text: Buy limit at 7420.78, the 57.5% retracement of the active up-swing. Resting from the daily-open anchor 09:00 broker (07:00 UK); the level sits 88.32 pts below the D-1 reference close 7509.10, the correct side for a buy limit.
management_text: Three equal units, filled only if price retraces to 7420.78. Unit 1 exits at TP1 7455.06 (38.2% retracement). Unit 2 exits at TP2 7522.90 (full retrace to the swing origin); on the Unit-2 fill the Unit-3 stop moves to entry + 0.2R = 7439.23. Unit 3 (runner) traces to the 100% extension 7700.50; when price prints above the 100% extension the runner stop moves instead to the 50% mark of the original 1:1 leg, halfway between entry 7420.78 and TP2 7522.90 = 7471.84 - the one structural override of the universal trail. Wide-stop flag SET: R = 92.23 pts = 1.38 x ATR14 (> 1.00). Thesis invalidation (separate from the stop): a daily close beyond the swing-low anchor 7345.30.
rationale: VARIANT SELECTION: the regime label the report itself calls is TREND_UP - 9 states 'Composite regime label is TREND_UP' and adds that the dual-gate RANGE conditions are not met; 10 and every 21b card header repeat 'TREND_UP regime'. M5 5.3 maps TREND_UP to variant 3A with no discretion, so 3A is the fork emitted here. The report shipped a 3C Momentum-Breakout headed 'TREND_UP variant', which is a variant/label mismatch that M5 5.3 calls non-compliant; 3C is a TRANSITION-only variant and in any case had no confirmed break (its own 4d test needs a close at least 0.25 x ATR14 = 16.75 pts beyond the 25-session boundary: on the slice that is 7522.90 + 16.75 = 7539.65 against a D-1 close of 7509.10). REFERENCE CLOSE: 7509.10, dated 2026-05-14, the last completed US500 cash session strictly before D (16:30-23:00 broker), from the slice. ATR14 = 67.01 index points on the last 14 completed cash-session bars ending 2026-05-14 (true range); 2 x ATR14 = 134.02, 0.25 x ATR14 = 16.75, 2.5 x ATR14 = 167.53, 3.5 x ATR14 = 234.54. FIB SWING ANCHOR (M5 4b): starting at the default 4-session lookback (11-14 May), the most recent swing is low 7345.30 printed 2026-05-12 to high 7522.90 printed 2026-05-14; magnitude 177.60 pts = 2.65 x ATR14, which clears the 2 x ATR14 qualifying threshold at the default lookback, so no extension beyond 4 sessions was needed. The latest local high (14 May) is more recent than the latest local low (12 May), so the active swing is UP and retracements are measured low -> high, giving a long. Fib scale for an up-swing: 0% = swing high 7522.90, 100% = swing low 7345.30, width 177.60. ENTRY: 57.5% retracement (the midpoint of the 50% and 61.8% levels) = 7522.90 - 0.575 x 177.60 = 7522.90 - 102.12 = 7420.78. This is a buy limit and it sits 88.32 pts below the reference close 7509.10, i.e. at or below it as M5 5.0 requires of a buy limit. STOP: beyond the swing-low anchor by 0.25 x ATR14 = 7345.30 - 16.75 = 7328.55; the resulting stop distance 92.23 pts is well inside the 3.5 x ATR14 = 234.54 cap, so the cap does not bind. R = 7420.78 - 7328.55 = 92.23 pts = 1.38 x ATR14, inside the required band 0.3-3.0 x ATR14 = [20.10, 201.03]; because the ratio exceeds 1.00 the wide-stop flag is set by the arithmetic and carried in the management text. TP1: 38.2% retracement = 7522.90 - 0.382 x 177.60 = 7522.90 - 67.84 = 7455.06, which is 34.28 pts from entry, inside the 2.5 x ATR14 = 167.53 bound. TP2: the 0% mark, i.e. the swing origin high 7522.90 (14 May cash high). TP3: 100% extension of the swing = 7522.90 + 177.60 = 7700.50. Ladder is ordered stop 7328.55 < entry 7420.78 < TP1 7455.06 < TP2 7522.90 < TP3 7700.50. Every level on this card is derived from the slice swing endpoints and ATR14, not from pivots, so the report's pivot errors do not propagate here; the swing low it used (7370.20) is 24.90 pts above the slice low 7345.30 and the swing high it used (7505.30) is 17.60 pts below the slice high 7522.90, so using the slice moves the entry, the stop and all three targets. No pivot tier is referenced, so the single-source-indicative pivot flag that suppresses Trade 2 does not reach this card. No HIGH-impact scheduled US event appears on D in the calendar slice. Linter: CLEAN, zero DUD, zero WARN.
